title: MPN10 Simulator Security for XORP up to 2^n Queries
summary: The paper establishes full indifferentiable security with a simulator that differs on backward queries, but whether the original MPN10 simulator reaches the conjectured query threshold remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Does the original MPN10 simulator provide indifferentiable security for XORP up to $2^n$ queries?

scope.domain: Indifferentiability security of XORP, with emphasis on the query limit of the original simulator.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove or refute whether the original MPN10 simulator itself provides the stated indifferentiable-security guarantee for XORP.

citations.label: Full Indifferentiable Security of the Xor of Two or More Random Permutations Using the \chi ^2 Method

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents the original MPN10 simulator's security claim as a conjecture about its query capacity. The paper's proof uses a simulator that differs on backward queries, so it does not settle the original-simulator claim.
citation_labels: Srimanta Bhattacharya et al., Full Indifferentiable Security of the Xor of Two or More Random Permutations Using the \chi ^2 Method
